title: MLVisionRN: Powering Universal Vision Apps with React Native

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: with ML Vision RN developers can harness the power of react native to create high performance Vision applications that run flawlessly across multiple platforms this Universal application leverages react natives versatility to provide a consistent user experience on both Vision Pro and iPhone devices experience silky smooth performance at 60 frames per second ensuring a seamless and responsive user interface on every device in inspired by Apple's hello world example for vision OS ml Vision RN brings cross-platform Vision development to the Forefront while the code is provided as is and not officially supported by Apple or Facebook it offers a solid foundation for developers to build upon
